units.source_text: 箱根发生纠纷以来，我都是旁观者，一切与我无关，我什么都不插嘴。

en.t: Ever since the dispute arose at Hakone, I had remained a bystander; none of it concerned me, and I said nothing.

units.source_text: 就是现在，七段也不是同我商量，而是向我陈述。

en.t: Even now, the seventh-dan was not consulting me, but merely setting out the facts to me.

units.source_text: 两人面对面坐着，我倾听着七段诉说苦衷，这才第一次动了心思：

en.t: As the two of us sat facing each other and I listened to the seventh-dan explain his difficulties, the thought came to me for the first time:

units.source_text: 我倒可以出面调停说点意见。

en.t: perhaps I could step in as a mediator and offer a few words of opinion.
